# motionwind-vue

Write Motion animations as Tailwind-like `animate-*` classes in Vue 3. Powered by
[Motion for Vue](https://motion.dev/docs/vue) (`motion-v`). Same class syntax as the React package.

## Install

```bash
npm install motionwind-vue motion-v
```

## Option A — build-time transform (write plain elements, like React's Babel plugin)

`vite.config.ts`:

```ts
import { defineConfig } from "vite";
import vue from "@vitejs/plugin-vue";
import { motionwindTransform } from "motionwind-vue/vite";

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [vue({ template: { compilerOptions: { nodeTransforms: [motionwindTransform] } } })],
});
```

`main.ts` — register the runtime component once:

```ts
import { createApp } from "vue";
import { MotionwindPlugin } from "motionwind-vue";
import App from "./App.vue";
createApp(App).use(MotionwindPlugin).mount("#app");
```

Now plain elements with static `class` work:

```vue
<template>
  <button class="animate-hover:scale-110 animate-tap:scale-90 animate-spring">Click me</button>
</template>
```

The transform rewrites native elements whose static `class` contains `animate-*` into
`<Motionwind as="tag">`. Only static `class` is transformed (dynamic `:class` → use Option B).

## Option B — runtime component (no build step)

```vue
<script setup>
import { Motionwind, mw } from "motionwind-vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Motionwind as="button" class="animate-hover:scale-110">Click</Motionwind>
  <!-- or the proxy in render fns: h(mw.button, { class: "animate-hover:scale-110" }) -->
</template>
```

Composable:

```ts
import { useMotionwind } from "motionwind-vue";
const { motionProps, tailwindClasses, hasMotion } = useMotionwind("animate-hover:scale-110");
```

## Notes / gotchas

- Motion for Vue names the tap gesture **`whilePress`** (not `whileTap`); the adapter maps
  motionwind's `animate-tap:*` to it automatically.
- **`prefers-reduced-motion`** is honored: gesture/entrance props are stripped so content renders
  at its resting state with no motion.
- **Scroll-linked** (`animate-scroll:*`) is not yet supported in Vue (a dev warning is logged and
  the class is ignored). Use `useScroll` from `motion-v` directly, or the React/Vanilla adapters.
- Supported: hover, tap, focus, in-view, initial/enter/exit, transitions, drag, layout, variants.
